located_point.method: Initial indexed point was checked in two-scale composites. Abhayan et al.2025 section4.4 gives22degrees49min17.5sec N,69degrees35min49.9sec E, about1.5km north of index. Rendered a fresh 2km/800m four-layer set around that published coordinate; adopted it provisionally, without a secure ancient wall identification.

composite.rights_notice: Copernicus Sentinel data terms; Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2018–2026
composite.transformation: Median per band; brightness mean of B02 B03 B04 B08

sources.assessment: At both coordinates the composite shows cultivated plots, drainage and modern disturbance. No securely identified ancient straight line is resolved.

notes: Published point improves location provenance but does not authenticate visible geometry. No ancient bearing or registration. Relocation helper initially failed while reading UTF-8 JSON with default cp1252; -X utf8 resolved it before any render was written.
unmeasurable_reason: No eligible architectural plan or identified straight Harappan feature in prepared imagery, including the published site coordinate.
imagery_assessment: At both coordinates the composite shows cultivated plots, drainage and modern disturbance. No securely identified ancient straight line is resolved.
plan_assessment: Live library has no eligible plan. Abhayan et al.2025 section4.4 describes surface surveys2013-17 and two test pits in2015, without identifying a long architectural edge. Commercial panelE was not opened or measured.

empirical_error_calibration.sigma_policy: Tool sigma retained unchanged; calibration is separate.
